who: claude-opus-5-5 (Claude Opus 5.5), host round 2 lane 'made facts', port-memo-1113
where: crates/hir-ty-pure/src/walk.rs fold; crates/hir-ty-pure/src/values.rs Values::solve; crates/hir-ty-pure/src/memory.rs infer; crates/hir-ty-pure/src/locks.rs of
what: Cutting a body's own effects (the made Effects fact) at the point the walk first reads a callee's summary leaves three passes that still need the body's MIR after the cut: the locals' values (a fixpoint over statements fed callees' returned values), the memory inference and the lock summary. So the own part is not body-free, and its digest has to cover the body's text, so a statement edit that changes no effect still moves it.
cost: an hour finding that the fold could not be made over own parts alone, and a digest weaker than the end state
cause: each dataflow pass takes the callees' answers as inputs at the point it reads them inside a body walk, instead of reducing the body once to a callee-parametric transfer (a per-site summary with holes for each callee's answer)
class: an interprocedural analysis whose per-body part is not separated from its join, so the per-body fact cannot be cached by what it reads
prevention: give values, memory and locks a body-free reduced form (per site: what flows in and out, the callee's answer as a parameter), made in own_part, and make fold read only that
workaround: OwnEffects::code (the body's early identity) is in the digest, so the made fact is correct but moves on any body edit
